description: Phase-1 deliverable: validation schema + current valid parameters for Meta Marketing API asset creation. Re-harvest before each run. Values reflect public Meta for Developers changelog research as of 2026-05; verify against a live API probe before trusting in production.

deprecations.what: All Marketing API versions earlier than v24.0
deprecations.action: Pin every call to v24.0 or later.

deprecations.what: Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns and Advantage+ App Campaigns (ASC/AAC)
deprecations.action: No create/duplicate/update on any version. Migrate to standard Advantage+ campaigns.
Do not rely on narrow interest filters; treat detailed targeting as a suggestion only.

reporting.note: 100+ metrics were phased out starting 2026-01-12. Validate any insights 'fields' list against a live get_insights probe before trusting historical pulls.

targeting.note: Audience inputs are AI suggestions, not binding filters, in most campaign types. Programmatic >40% audience-overlap flagging is unreliable post-consolidation; use campaign-fragmentation heuristics instead.

status.note: PLATFORM PROTECTION RULE: the agent must create every creative/ad as PAUSED. ACTIVE is operator-only.
